One thing I always found a problem with Reddit was how people abused the downvote button. Somebody would make a comment that, while not really that radical, broke the current circlejerk of the thread, and got a ton of downvotes. I see this as Reddit didn't really effectively inform people what the downvote button was for - a button for saying that the post did not add to the discussion. Instead people used it as the anti circlejerk button most of the time, which created a closed environment that discouraged open discussion. Sites like RateYourMusic have this downvote policy down, and it works really well. I feel like Voat would be a much better place if it encouraged responsible use of the downvoat button, basically.
Advocate the use of the downvote button as a 'did not add to discussion' button versus a 'I disagree button'

Perhaps we should instead rely on 'downvote reasons'. People should see why others are having a problem with a post and, if people submit bogus reasons (blank or just spammy), perhaps they can be punished?
